messages:
harry: FYI ran onboarding sweep for willow-emb-v3 (fp16 baseline) vs willow-emb-v3-quant (int6-perchannel) on short+mixed queries. seeing recall@10 drop and a silhouette score fall for clustering. can someone help triage?
ina: can you paste the eval invocation and top numbers?
harry: command: `./evals/run_all.sh --model willow-emb-v3 --quant int6 --suites short,mixed --k 10 --index prod-k50`
harry: top-line: baseline fp16 recall@10 = 0.926, quant int6 recall@10 = 0.880 (delta -0.046). silhouette baseline = 0.21, quant = 0.12.
Tess: that's sizable for recall@10. did you check per-language breakdown? mixed suite contains en/es/ja.
harry: uploaded split csv: s3://redwood-evals/willow/v3/mixed/split_breakdown.csv. quick peek: en drop -3%, es -7%, ja -9%. short queries (len<=6) worst.
Tess: run idflip and recall-by-length: `python evals/idflip.py --old willow-v3-fp16 --new willow-v3-int6 --k 10 --by-length`
eval-bot: idflip queued (job id w-5523). ETA ~2m
ina: also compare L2 norm and cosine distributions: `python evals/dist_compare.py --old willow-v3-fp16 --new willow-v3-int6 --sample 5000`
harry: dist compare shows median cosine shifted from 0.845 -> 0.815 for short queries. norms slightly compressed (median 2.9 -> 2.6).
Tess: run umap on 300 anchors and compute pairwise neighbor preservation (k=10). sometimes quant preserves global but breaks local neighborhood.
harry: umap uploaded https://console.redwood/embeds/willow/5523456789/umap.png. neighbor-preservation k10 = 72% vs baseline 89%.
Tess: that indicates local topology degradation. try int8-perchannel and int6-pertensor to isolate bitwidth vs scheme. also test symmetric quantization and clip-to-percentile before scale calc.
nina: kicked int8-perchannel run. infra-bot: deploy willow-v3-int6 staging completed. latency +1ms p50, mem -14%.
eval-bot: int8 run complete: recall@10 = 0.922, silhouette = 0.20 (close to baseline).
harry: int8 looks fine. so int6 quantizer likely the culprit.
Tess: quick mitigation: prefer int8-perchannel in routing for now and mark int6 as experimental. i'll open ticket Q-912 to adjust int6 calibrator (try symmetric + per-channel clip at 99.5 percentile).
harry: action items: Tess prototype calibrator patch + smoke eval, nina run int6-pertensor, i'll document results and hold rollout. thanks all.
